# Linear Regression Explainer - Workspace Instructions

This workspace contains an interactive Linear Regression Explainer built with Svelte, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

## Project Overview
An interactive visualization tool that helps students learn how linear regression works through the ice cream sales example (predicting sales based on temperature using y = mx + c).

## Tech Stack
- Svelte + TypeScript
- Vite (build tool)
- Tailwind CSS (styling)
- D3.js (data visualization)

## Next Steps

### 1. Install Node.js
Node.js is required to run this project. Download and install from:
**https://nodejs.org/** (Choose the LTS version)

After installation, restart your terminal and verify with:
```powershell
node --version
npm --version
```

### 2. Install Dependencies
Once Node.js is installed, run:
```powershell
npm install
```

### 3. Start Development Server
```powershell
npm run dev
```

Then open your browser to `http://localhost:5173`

## Project Structure
- `src/components/` - Svelte UI components
- `src/stores/` - State management with Svelte stores
- `src/App.svelte` - Main application
- `index.html` - Entry point
- All configuration files are in place
